models_evaluated: two external research lesion detection AI algorithms for 18F-FDG PET

links.outcome: Comparison of two lesion detection AIs on same synthetic lesion library by sensitivity and precision
links.effect: One AI consistently outperformed the other in number of reported lesions, sensitivity, and precision. 10 mm lesions detected at 90% sensitivity at 8:1 vs 16:1 lesion-to-background ratio for the two algorithms.
links.quote: One AI consistently outperformed the other in terms of number of reported lesions, sensitivity, and precision.

unlisted_practices: Using synthetic lesions inserted into real patient PET/CT data to characterize AI limits of detection
Psychophysical response model fitting to compare detection performance by lesion size and contrast

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation/stress-testing of two external AI lesion-detection models using synthetic lesions in PET/CT to evaluate limits of detection; does not evaluate a clinical deployment practice or safeguard.
